situations.headline: Home REIT completes final property disposals, moves to subsidiary liquidation ahead of capital return

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Home REIT completes final property disposals, moves to subsidiary liquidation ahead of capital return (interest 5, risk 6)

thesis.text: Home REIT is in the final stages of a managed wind-down: all property sales are complete (residual 144 properties realized £16.14m vs £17.35m valuation) and subsidiary liquidations are imminent, positioning the company for an eventual shareholder capital return. The remaining uncertainty and key risk factor is the unresolved group litigation/claims exposure, which the Board explicitly states continues to constrain distributions; the size and timing of any capital return will hinge on resolution of these claims rather than further asset realization risk.
